subject.title: Feature: Distinguish webchat client types (Mac app vs browser)

question: Which WebChat client metadata may agents see, and must it be derived only from validated Gateway connect identity rather than untrusted browser or app hints?
rationale: The remaining work crosses from Gateway diagnostic metadata into agent-visible context that can influence behavior, so automation should not choose the trust model or permanent API shape.

options.title: Expose validated Gateway identity only
options.body: Add typed agent context fields from validated connect.client id, mode, platform, and device metadata, while keeping ad hoc hints out of agent authority.

options.title: Expose untrusted hints as diagnostics
options.body: Allow browser/app hints only when clearly marked untrusted, accepting extra API complexity for debugging flexibility.

options.title: Keep identity diagnostic-only
options.body: Leave client identity in Gateway connection state and logs until maintainers approve a stronger agent-facing use case.

recommendation.title: Expose validated Gateway identity only
recommendation.body: Add typed agent context fields from validated connect.client id, mode, platform, and device metadata, while keeping ad hoc hints out of agent authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the Gateway auth/security trust boundary for client metadata.
